outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum (one set of mass peaks with relative intensities) for PacL1 with cadmium. No averaging, error bars, or statistical summary is presented, and the caption does not state whether this spectrum is representative of repeated acquisitions. As no combined/averaged replicate data is shown, replicate reporting is not required here.

Like panel A, panel B shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1Δ5 with cadmium, without averaging or error bars. No replicate number or type is stated, but since no averaged/statistical data is displayed, replicate reporting is not required.

Panel C shows the proportion of purified proteins bound to specific numbers of cadmium atoms, derived directly from single native MS spectra (as in panels A/B). No error bars, n numbers, or statement of independent/biological replicates are given, and the bars appear to represent single-spectrum quantification rather than averaged replicate data, so replicate reporting is not required.

Panel D shows proportions of metal-bound species (zinc) for PacL1, PacL1Δ5 and PacL2 from native MS, with no error bars or stated n. As with panel C, this appears to be single-spectrum-derived quantification rather than an average across replicates, so no replicate count/type needed to be reported.

Panel E shows proportions of copper-bound species for the three proteins from native MS, without error bars or any n/replicate statement. As no averaged or repeated-measurement data is indicated, replicate reporting is not required for this panel.

Panel F shows proportions of manganese-bound species for the three proteins from native MS, without error bars or a stated n/replicate type. As with the other proportion panels, this appears to be single-measurement-derived data, so replicate reporting is not required.

Panel G shows chemical shift perturbations (CSPs) per residue at three different zinc equivalents (0.4, 1.0, 2) from a single NMR titration experiment on PacL1. These bars represent different titration points, not experimental replicates, and no error bars, averaging, or n value is shown, so replicate reporting does not apply.

Panel H shows CSPs per residue at three cadmium equivalents from a single NMR titration on PacL1, analogous to panel G. No averaging or replicate data is presented, so no replicate number/type needed to be reported.
